title: Fair by design: A sociotechnical approach to justifying the fairness of AI-enabled systems cross the lifecycle
reasoning: The paper introduces the 'Trustworthy and Ethical Assurance' (TEA) framework, which is specifically designed to provide a structured, reviewable argument for the ethical acceptability and fairness of AI systems. It discusses fairness as a philosophical and normative concept and applies ethical assurance methodology to a medical case study.
